description: Universal structural closed lists for atom.meaning.kind — content shapes that are NOT specific to any source type (procedures, forms, and courses all have lists). Additive to atom.meaning.kind, same governance pattern as procedure.enum.json / intent.enum.json. A list is decomposed into a List container + ListItem children, never a \n-delimited string.

governance.rule: Atoms may only use structural meaning.kind ids defined here. New values require a version bump and an entry.
governance.scope: atom.meaning.kind (structural values only — the field stays open for source-type and other content kinds).

meaning_kind.description: Additive GOVERNED structural values for atom.meaning.kind. Source-type-agnostic; shared across procedure / form / course.

values.label: List
values.definition: An ordered or unordered list container. Its meaning is the list's lead-in / caption; its entries are child atoms (kind list_item) via object.belongs_to. Never a newline-delimited string.

values.label: List Item
values.definition: A single entry within a list. Its meaning is the item text; its place is object.order within the parent list. A leaf.
